properties.notes: Linear parcel of land occupied by an existing dwelling, small outbuildings and associated land. May offer potential as part of a wider scheme for redevelopment which would involve the regeneration of former industrial land at the Cambois Colliery site (5098, 5047, 5048). Relatively low yield recognises physical constraints. The site is outwith the identified settlement boundary identified in the Local Plan. No residential development is forecast within the plan period at present.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
